summary: BarCada is a multi-city commercial event company (umbrella of 'Ermantourage') running templated 'Dinner with Strangers' and 'Coffee with Strangers' event series in dozens of cities nationwide, not just Asheville. Each ticketed event ($23-$34) pairs two strangers one-on-one at a rotating restaurant or cafe based on a post-signup questionnaire about age, interests, and favorite foods; the 'Duos Edition' format is explicitly a one-time algorithmic pairing, not a returning membership.

evidence.note: 23 near-daily 'Dinner with Strangers' listings and 5 weekly 'Coffee with Strangers' listings, each at a different 'Restaurant/Cafe of the Day', priced $23-$34, described as 'meet a new friend one-on-one' with no mention of members, dues, or a group identity.
Tags include 'rotating-restaurant', 'structured networking', 'Icebreaker Prompts', 'Paired Seating' - language describing a facilitated matching service rather than a club with recurring attendees.

Eventbrite organizer page describes BarCada as 'the umbrella company of Ermantourage, an event series catering to the entertainment scene and the general public, which produces gatherings in many major cities.'

WebSearch turned up BarCada/Ermantourage running the identical 'Dinner with Strangers' and 'My 20's/30's in <city>' template in Arvada, Pomona, Warwick, Southlake TX, Albuquerque, Rocky Mount and other cities, confirming it is a nationwide commercial franchise format, not an Asheville-specific community.
No Asheville-specific Facebook group, Meetup, Discord, or 'about us' page for a local BarCada community was found; only the generic Eventbrite ticketing pages.
